pathways.name: Apoptosis
pathways.description: Intrinsic and extrinsic programmed cell death; dysregulation contributes to autoimmunity and cancer.

pathways.name: Coagulation Cascade
pathways.description: Plasma coagulation factors and fibrinolysis; a hub for cardiovascular and thrombotic disease.

pathways.name: ECM Remodeling
pathways.description: Matrix metalloproteinases and extracellular matrix turnover in tissue remodeling and fibrosis.

pathways.name: Hedgehog Signaling
pathways.description: Hedgehog morphogen signaling governing embryonic patterning and stem cell maintenance.

pathways.name: MAPK / ERK Signaling
pathways.description: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade coupling growth factor receptors to proliferation and differentiation.

pathways.name: NF-κB Pathway
pathways.description: Canonical and non-canonical NF-κB activation driving pro-inflammatory gene expression.

pathways.name: TGF-β Signaling
pathways.description: Transforming growth factor beta signaling controlling fibrosis, immune tolerance, and tumor suppression.

pathways.name: TNF Signaling
pathways.description: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily signaling; central to many autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

pathways.name: Type I Interferon Pathway
pathways.description: IFN-α/β production and signaling through IFNAR; drives the interferon gene signature in autoimmune disease.

pathways.name: Wnt Signaling
pathways.description: Canonical Wnt/β-catenin signaling controlling cell fate, proliferation, and tissue regeneration.

pathways.name: Xenobiotic Metabolism
pathways.description: Cytochrome P450 and conjugating enzymes governing drug metabolism and toxicity.
